fields.description: Who is your customer and what problem do they have?
fields.label: Problem
fields.placeholder: e.g. Farmers lose 30-50% income to middlemen who control buyer access.

fields.description: How big is the opportunity?
fields.label: Market Size
fields.placeholder: e.g. TAM: 200K+ farmers in Rwanda (NISR 2023). SOM Year 1: 500 farmers.

fields.description: What did you learn from talking to real customers?
fields.label: Discovery
fields.placeholder: e.g. 47 farmers interviewed. 82% said price uncertainty was their biggest problem.

fields.description: What stage is the product at?
fields.label: Stage
fields.placeholder: e.g. MVP live on WhatsApp. 12 farmers using it weekly.

fields.description: Core features today.
fields.label: Features
fields.placeholder: e.g. SMS registration, weekly availability posting, SMS order confirmation.

fields.description: Feedback you have received and what you changed.
fields.label: Testing
fields.placeholder: e.g. Farmers wanted bulk order option. Added in Week 3.

fields.description: Your channels and approach.
fields.label: Go-To-Market Strategy
fields.placeholder: e.g. Cooperatives, direct farm visits, restaurant procurement managers.

fields.description: What you have so far: flyer, one-pager, brand sample, social posts, anything.
fields.label: Marketing Assets
fields.placeholder: e.g. Brand kit (logo, colors, 3 social posts), 1 printed flyer for cooperatives.

fields.description: What have you spent and where did the money come from?
fields.label: Financial History
fields.placeholder: e.g. Spent RWF 450,000 to date. Bootstrapped from savings.

fields.description: Revenue and cost projections with clear assumptions.
fields.label: Projections
fields.placeholder: e.g. Year 1: 500 farmers, 2% transaction fee = RWF 10M revenue.

fields.description: What it costs to get a customer and what they are worth.
fields.label: Unit Economics
fields.placeholder: e.g. CAC: RWF 8,000. LTV: RWF 60,000. Ratio: 7.5:1.

fields.description: How much and what it will be spent on.
fields.label: Ask
fields.placeholder: e.g. Raising RWF 15M pre-seed. 40% engineering, 30% outreach, 30% ops.

fields.description: Is the business legally registered?
fields.label: Business Registration
fields.placeholder: e.g. Registered as SARL in Rwanda. RDB Certificate No. XXX.

fields.description: Written agreements with co-founders, team, key suppliers.
fields.label: Contracts
fields.placeholder: e.g. Founder agreement: 60/40 split, 4-year vest, 1-year cliff.

fields.description: Sector-specific laws, tax registration, cross-border rules if any.
fields.label: Compliance
fields.placeholder: e.g. Tax-registered with RRA. Agritech: NAEB cooperative regs apply. No cross-border yet.

fields.description: Equity ownership breakdown. One line summary plus the spreadsheet.
fields.label: Cap Table
fields.placeholder: e.g. Founder A: 60%, Founder B: 35%, ESOP reserved: 5%.

fields.description: Paste a Canva or Google Slides link, or upload your deck.
fields.label: Pitch Deck Link
fields.placeholder: e.g. https://www.canva.com/design/...

fields.description: The one thing investors should remember after your pitch.
fields.label: Company Hook
fields.placeholder: e.g. A farmer can grow 500kg and earn less than the person driving the truck.

fields.description: Measurable outcomes. Users served, jobs created, % income or productivity change, SDG alignment if relevant.
fields.label: Impact Metrics
fields.placeholder: e.g. 47 farmers onboarded. RWF 1.2M extra income generated in 8 weeks. SDG 1 (poverty), SDG 8 (decent work).

fields.description: Signed agreements, letters of intent, pilot deals. Logos of partners if you have permission.
fields.label: Partnerships
fields.placeholder: e.g. MoU with Kigali Farmers Cooperative (signed Apr 2026, 12-month pilot).

fields.description: Real quotes from customers, or short case studies of how your product changed their life or business.
fields.label: Testimonials
fields.placeholder: e.g. 'I made 40% more this season because I knew the price before I left the farm.' — Marie U., farmer, Musanze

fields.description: The one reason a customer picks you over everything else.
fields.label: Unique Value Proposal
fields.placeholder: e.g. Only platform that gets fair prices to farmers without a smartphone.

fields.description: Users, sales, pilots, partnerships, anything real.
fields.label: Traction and Revenue
fields.placeholder: e.g. 47 farmers, 12 buyers, 23 orders, RWF 1.2M in 8 weeks.

fields.description: Key assets and how you are protecting them.
fields.label: IP Protection
fields.placeholder: e.g. AgriLink trademark filed with OPIC Rwanda (pending).

fields.description: Who else is solving this and why will customers choose you?
fields.label: Competition and Edge
fields.placeholder: e.g. No direct SMS-based competitor in Rwanda. Middlemen are the status quo.
